string-array.name: daily_quotes
string-array.item: Every entry is a piece of the puzzle.
Small notes today, clearer patterns tomorrow.
You do not have to be perfect. Just keep going.
A missed day is fine. The next entry counts just as much.
Listening to your body is a skill. You are practising it.
Patterns need time. You are giving them that time.
Ten seconds today can save you guesswork later.
Curiosity is a good companion on this journey.
Good days are clues too.
Write it down, then let it go.
You know your body better than any app. This one just takes notes.
Every confirmed day makes the picture sharper.
No pressure, no streaks. Just clues.
What you notice today may matter next week.
Being consistent beats being complete.
A calm look at the facts helps more than worrying.
You are collecting evidence, not judging yourself.
One meal at a time.
Sleep and stress belong in the story as well.
Your notes stay with you. Only on this phone.
The detective work is quiet, but it adds up.
Even "nothing happened" is useful information.
A few taps now, a better conversation with your doctor later.
You are doing this for yourself. That counts.
Clues do not need to be big to be helpful.
Today is a good day for a short entry.
Notice, note, move on.
Your future self will thank you for these notes.
Patience turns many small notes into a clear pattern.
Feeling fine is worth noting, too.
Every day you log is a day with more certainty.
There is no wrong entry. Only more information.
Take a breath. Then take a note.
Step by step, the picture becomes clearer.
Your observations are valuable.
It is okay to start again any day.
A good detective writes things down.
Slow and steady finds the clues.
Kindness to yourself is part of the process.
Today counts, whatever today brings.
